evidence: We demonstrate a method to intimately bond a free-standing nanoporous anodic aluminum oxide (AAO) template onto a piece of gold-coated high reﬂective index glass (LaSFN9) substrate by an atomic layer deposition (ALD) technique. The capability of ALD as “nanoglue” is well demonstrated by the optical waveguide behavior of the bonded sample. We monitored the optical behavior before and after ALD of TiO2 with no exciting waveguide modes in the sample before ALD.
